relations.text: Microsoft Azureの独立系大手サービス会社を2026年1月に買収
relations.text_en: Acquired one of the largest independent Microsoft Azure services providers in January 2026

source.label: Cognizant 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On January 1, 2026, we acquired 100 % ownership in 3Cloud, one of the largest independent Microsoft Azure services providers and a global leader in Azure-dedicated AI enablement solutions and products.

companies.sub: 航空宇宙のエンジニアリング

relations.text: 航空宇宙・防衛向けの研究開発サービス会社を2024年8月に買収
relations.text_en: Acquired the aerospace and defense engineering R&D services firm in August 2024

source.label: Cognizant 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On August 26, 2024, through the execution of a merger agreement, we acquired 100 % ownership in Belcan, a leading global supplier of engineering research & development services for the commercial aerospace, defense, space, marine and industrial verticals.

relations.text: ServiceNowの導入支援会社を2024年1月に買収
relations.text_en: Acquired the ServiceNow implementation partner in January 2024

source.label: Cognizant 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On January 22, 2024, through the execution of a share purchase agreement, we acquired 100 % owners hip in Thirdera, an Elite ServiceNow Partner specializing in advisory, implementation and optimization solutions related to the ServiceNow platform.

relations.text: Pearsonが、AI戦略のパートナー契約を結んだ専門サービス企業の一社としてコグニザントを挙げる

source.label: Pearson 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: We secured strategic partnerships with hyperscaler partners (Microsoft, AWS and Google Cloud) and leading professional services enterprises (including HCLTech, Cognizant and IBM).
